label: auto-prepare setting
type: a service-level setting causing the Query engine to create a n1ql:prepare-d statement for every SQL++ request automatically, whether or not PREPARE was used explicitly. Inactive by default.
relates_to_competency_question: Does every SQL++ statement get implicitly prepared for reuse, or only ones the client explicitly prepares?
evidence: Specifies whether the query engine should create a prepared statement every time a SQL++ request is submitted, whether the PREPARE statement is included or not.
The auto-prepare feature is inactive by default. You can turn the auto-prepare feature on or off using the `auto-prepare` service-level query setting.
Prepared statements created by the auto-prepare feature are not executed by the auto-execute feature.
